presets.name: Octave ring
presets.desc: Neck humbucker, tone rolled back: the rectified octave rings over sustained notes above the 12th fret

refs.why: transformer octave fuzz on the neck pickup, high on the neck

presets.notes: Play single notes above the 12th fret and let them ring: 2f up to 24 dB over f on a held note at L_m = 1 H

presets.name: Octave bloom
presets.desc: The pick attack in fuzz, the octave growing as the note decays and the input clamp lets go
presets.notes: Hold single notes: the coupling capacitors release the bias over a few tens of ms and the octave swells in

presets.name: Octave blend
presets.desc: Half fuzz, half octave: the octave as a colour on a plain fuzz, chords stay readable
presets.notes: octave 50 % is a clone's lifted-diode position to first order: one half-wave added to the fuzz

presets.name: Ring chords
presets.desc: Full fuzz on double stops and bends: ring-modulator intermodulation and dive-bombs
presets.notes: The rectifier multiplies the notes of a double stop: sum and difference tones, the dive on a bent double stop

presets.name: Octave lead, hot
presets.desc: Raised bias and a 12 V supply: Q3 further from saturation, the octave holds on harder picking
presets.notes: bias_v ≈ 7.5 V at 12 V (4.9 V stock at 9 V): more headroom before the duty moves; to be judged by ear
